expect.notes: The --resume argument is captured: the driver passes sessions.main.resume and asserts the fake's captured value equals it. Derived fixture: init and result carry a different, fixed session UUID. Init cannot accept, and wrong-session traffic cannot accept the requested turn, so acceptance and progress are absent. Every init/result ID is checked; mismatch emits resume.mismatch, never confirms or replaces the session and never resends (C2 §2 reopen, §4, §7 item 4; packet §2). The TurnEnd carries no terminal (coordinator ruling). Replay pins no resend (strict trailing input) and stdin EOF after the result; C2 does not say whether the adapter stops a mismatched process earlier, and the fixture assumes the normal close after the result.
